character.description: The same young adult female anime protagonist: soft auburn hair in twin braids, soft rose-brown eyes, a thoughtful face with gently angled features; an independent explorer of remote waters and wild places, wearing a weather-ready expedition coat, layered travel clothes, and practical boots with deep ocean blue accents. Keep this exact face, hair, eyes, body proportions, and signature outfit in every scene.
consistency_rules: Use this exact protagonist identity in every scene; do not redesign, replace, or randomly reinterpret the character.
Preserve the same face, hairstyle, hair color, eye color, age impression, and body proportions.
Keep the signature outfit silhouette, defining accessories, and main color accents consistent across the entire music video.
Do not introduce another protagonist unless the lyrics or scene explicitly require one.

visual_language.action_style: expressive, readable full-body gestures; natural movement; clear pose silhouettes; avoid static repeated poses
visual_language.environment_style: rich anime background design rooted in deep sea canyon, coral garden, sunken temple; preserve the theme's distinctive world and recognizable environmental details
visual_language.lighting_style: cinematic lighting harmonized with deep ocean blue, teal, bioluminescent cyan, violet; coherent light direction, atmospheric depth, and controlled highlights
visual_language.composition_style: varied cinematic framing informed by underwater wide shot, slow floating camera, macro bubbles and coral; clear subject separation and intentional negative space

camera_guidance.principle: vary shot scale and viewpoint to support the scene; avoid repeating identical framing in consecutive scenes
